name: com.applozic.mobicomkit.api.conversation.ApplozicIntentService
description: The Kommunicate (Applozic) chat SDK runs this background service after a network or device-clock change. It synchronizes queued and deleted messages and user status, or refreshes the time offset used for chat timestamps.
disableEffect: Queued messages, deletions, or user status may remain out of sync after reconnecting, and chat times may be wrong after a clock change.
